description: Pick 1 or more items from a list of up to 1000, each equally likely. Without repeats by default. The answer is a drawstoday.com link where the result is shown; the answer itself carries no result.

description.name: prismtect_number
description.description: A personal two-digit number from the Prismtect glass prism, for a user who asks for a lucky number, a number of their own or a number for today. Only a human touch can draw it, so this tool gives no number: it gives the link your user taps themselves. Pass the link on.
